a:r.a:t: Poster narrative and local visual assets adapted from Docs/Poster.md.
- DQN card and temporary learner-comparison graphic: Assets/DQN Win.png.

- DQN_103 cross-player-count evaluation: Checkpoints/DQN_103/evaluations/top5_checkpoint_win_rates_all_player_counts.png; checkpoint_eval_ep006200_to_006700.json. Evaluation protocol: 54 games per checkpoint (3 seeds x learner seat x 3-6 total players), epsilon 0, 2,000-step cap.

- Historical implementation: commit 1411c0d (reward.py and train_constants.py). Dense learner-action terms were summed, clipped to [-10,+10], then multiplied by 0.1; terminal reward was unscaled. End-of-turn board progress was separately scaled by 0.1 and measured after opponents acted.

- The poster table summarizes terminal, trade, reinforce, attack, occupy/fortify, and board-progress terms in plain language. Docs/Reward.md contains the full current reward reference; it does not retroactively describe DQN_103's historical values.
Branding and QR assets are local project assets; Weizmann logo was user-provided.
